description: This file defines the 'NoteCardComponent' Angular component, responsible for displaying a note's content and providing edit and delete functionalities within the note-taking application.

classes.name: NoteCardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that displays a note's preview, creation date, update date, and provides emitters for editing and deleting the note.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Emits an edit event with the note's ID to notify parent components that editing is requested.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Emits a delete event with the note's ID to notify parent components that deletion is requested.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Returns a sanitized preview of the note's content, truncated to 140 characters if necessary, or a default message if empty.

methods.name: updatedLabel
methods.description: Returns the note's last updated timestamp formatted as a locale-specific string.

methods.name: createdLabel
methods.description: Returns the note's creation timestamp formatted as a locale-specific string.
